text.text_excerpt: I have been here twice in the last couple of weeks. Stopped in the first time with a friend after an exercise class nearby. We ordered very little and the bartender, Peter, was so helpful and nice to us. I got a side salad and my friend had the Godfather. SO DAMN GOOD! The meatballs are well seasoned and the sweet peppers top it off perfectly. Went back again this evening to get take out for my fiance and stepson. Peter served me again an was very nice and attentive. When I got home, they might as well have given me a standing ovation for bringing them these delicious sandwiches. The Godfather (obviously) and the T.A.S.T.E. sandwich. My fiance hates eggs on sandwiches but figured he would...

Super happy the place wasn't very busy. The service was great and very friendly. If you make the happy hour I highly recommend the bruschetta. Ugh... amazing. The french75 was a bit boozy but certainly hit the spot especially after the on the way drink. None the less I can't speak highly enough of The Godfather... amaze balls!!! Literally. The meatball sandwich is far to messy to go without silverware so be sure to ask if it's not on deck. Hope your visit is as superb as mine.

I was only there for HH and not hungry enough to try the TASTE, which is most definitely what I will get on my next visit. There was only one bartender but she was super efficient and really friendly. I tried the patatas bravas, the bruschetta, and the melanzanni, all of which were tasty. I love that their happy hour is from 3 to 8!! Sometimes it's hard for me to get to HHs that end at 6, so this is a huge plus for me. I'll be back, Part & Parcel!
